theorem lg_target {α : Type u_2} [Field α] [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] : Archimedean α := by
  intros a b ha hb
  cases le_total b 0 with h1 h2
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := dense_in_self (by exact_modcst ha) (by exact_modcst h1)
    use n
    exact hn
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := dense_in_self (by exact_modcst ha) (by exact_modcst h2)
    use n
    exact hn
